c001.coordinator_notes: Predictions 1-6 (H_Z, H_XX, H_ZZ, propagator) are generic Hamiltonian forms not supported by the abstract: the abstract says Ising-type nearest and second-nearest couplings, and an XX flip-flop term is unverified. They were not used as equations, since this scope is gate-level. Prediction 7 is kept as eq_1. Prediction 8, w=|0000>, was rejected as an unsupported choice; w is left as a parameter. I added the standard Grover equations. The paper was not read, and this does not reproduce the paper's Rabi-frequency result.

c003.coordinator_notes: Revision after reviewer feedback: the H^{\otimes 4} layer is now explicitly part of the built unitary, acting on |0000>. The earlier build omitted it. The spec states k=3 for this instance and warns against floor(x) as a substitute for the round formula. The predicted Hamiltonian (eq. 1), the evolution U=exp(-iHt) (eq. 2) and the initial state (eq. 3) are not adopted. They are unverified, and eq. 3 has an inconsistent normalisation with n used both as the dimension and the sum bound. The pulse model is outside scope, so this is a partial reconstruction of the ideal algorithm only. I did not read the paper.
